shortDescription: Management of a disk of a Qemu(KVM) VM in a Proxmox VE cluster

options.name: aio
options.description: AIO type to use.

options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_HOST) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_otp
options.description: Specify the OTP. Uses the E(PROXMOX_OTP) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_port
options.description: Specify the target port of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PORT) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Time limit for requests towards the Proxmox VE API.

options.name: api_token_id
options.description: Specify the token ID. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_token_secret
options.description: Specify the token secret. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_USER) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: backup
options.description: Whether the drive should be included when making backups.

options.name: bps_max_length
options.description: Maximum length of total r/w I/O bursts in seconds.

options.name: bps_rd_max_length
options.description: Maximum length of read I/O bursts in seconds.

options.name: bps_wr_max_length
options.description: Maximum length of write I/O bursts in seconds.

options.name: bwlimit
options.description: Override I/O bandwidth limit (in KB/s). Used only when O(state=moved).

options.name: ca_path
options.description: Path to a local certificate, which will be used to verify TLS connections. Ignored if O(validate_certs=false).

options.name: cache
options.description: The drive's cache mode.

options.name: create
options.description: With O(create) flag you can control behavior of O(state=present). When O(create=disabled) it will not create new disk (if not exists) but will update options in existing disk. When O(create=regular) it will either create new disk (if not exists) or update options in existing disk. When O(create=forced) it will always create new disk (if disk exists it will be detached and left unused).

options.name: cyls
options.description: Force the drive's physical geometry to have a specific cylinder count.

options.name: delete_moved
options.description: Delete the original disk after successful copy. By default the original disk is kept as unused disk. Used only when O(state=moved).

options.name: detect_zeroes
options.description: Control whether to detect and try to optimize writes of zeroes.

options.name: discard
options.description: Control whether to pass discard/trim requests to the underlying storage.

options.name: disk
options.description: The disk key (V(unused[n]), V(ide[n]), V(sata[n]), V(scsi[n]), V(virtio[n]), V(efidisk[n]) or V(tpmstate[n])) you want to operate on. Disk buses (IDE, SATA and so on) have fixed ranges of V(n) that accepted by Proxmox API. For IDE: 0-3; for SCSI: 0-30; for SATA: 0-5; for VirtIO: 0-15; for Unused: 0-255; for EFI disk: 0; for TPM state: 0.

options.name: format
options.description: The drive's backing file's data format.

options.name: heads
options.description: Force the drive's physical geometry to have a specific head count.

options.name: import_from
options.description: Import volume from this existing one. Volume string format. V(<STORAGE>:<VMID>/<FULL_NAME>) or V(<ABSOLUTE_PATH>/<FULL_NAME>). V(<STORAGE>:import/<FULL_NAME>) for PVE 9.x and later, to use storage's import directory. Attention! Only root can use absolute paths. This parameter is mutually exclusive with O(size). Increase O(timeout) parameter when importing large disk images or using slow storage.

options.name: iops
options.description: Maximum total r/w I/O in operations per second. You can specify either total limit or per operation (mutually exclusive with O(iops_rd) and O(iops_wr)).

options.name: iops_max
options.description: Maximum unthrottled total r/w I/O pool in operations per second.

options.name: iops_max_length
options.description: Maximum length of total r/w I/O bursts in seconds.

options.name: iops_rd
options.description: Maximum read I/O in operations per second. You can specify either read or total limit (mutually exclusive with O(iops)).

options.name: iops_rd_max
options.description: Maximum unthrottled read I/O pool in operations per second.

options.name: iops_rd_max_length
options.description: Maximum length of read I/O bursts in seconds.

options.name: iops_wr
options.description: Maximum write I/O in operations per second. You can specify either write or total limit (mutually exclusive with O(iops)).

options.name: iops_wr_max
options.description: Maximum unthrottled write I/O pool in operations per second.

options.name: iops_wr_max_length
options.description: Maximum length of write I/O bursts in seconds.

options.name: iothread
options.description: Whether to use iothreads for this drive (only for SCSI and VirtIO).

options.name: iso_image
options.description: The ISO image to be mounted on the specified in O(disk) CD-ROM. O(media=cdrom) needs to be specified for this option to work. Use V(<STORAGE>:iso/<ISO_NAME>) to mount ISO. Use V(cdrom) to access the physical CD/DVD drive. Use V(none) to unmount image from existent CD-ROM or create empty CD-ROM drive.

options.name: mbps
options.description: Maximum total r/w speed in megabytes per second. Can be fractional but use with caution - fractionals less than 1 are not supported officially. You can specify either total limit or per operation (mutually exclusive with O(mbps_rd) and O(mbps_wr)).

options.name: mbps_max
options.description: Maximum unthrottled total r/w pool in megabytes per second.

options.name: mbps_rd
options.description: Maximum read speed in megabytes per second. You can specify either read or total limit (mutually exclusive with O(mbps)).

options.name: mbps_rd_max
options.description: Maximum unthrottled read pool in megabytes per second.

options.name: mbps_wr
options.description: Maximum write speed in megabytes per second. You can specify either write or total limit (mutually exclusive with O(mbps)).

options.name: mbps_wr_max
options.description: Maximum unthrottled write pool in megabytes per second.

options.name: media
options.description: The drive's media type.

options.name: name
options.description: The unique name of the VM. You can specify either O(name) or O(vmid) or both of them.

options.name: queues
options.description: Number of queues (SCSI only).

options.name: replicate
options.description: Whether the drive should considered for replication jobs.

options.name: rerror
options.description: Read error action.

options.name: ro
options.description: Whether the drive is read-only.

options.name: scsiblock
options.description: Whether to use scsi-block for full passthrough of host block device. Can lead to I/O errors in combination with low memory or high memory fragmentation on host.

options.name: secs
options.description: Force the drive's physical geometry to have a specific sector count.

options.name: serial
options.description: The drive's reported serial number, url-encoded, up to 20 bytes long.

options.name: shared
options.description: Mark this locally-managed volume as available on all nodes. This option does not share the volume automatically, it assumes it is shared already!

options.name: size
options.description: Desired volume size in GiB to allocate when O(state=present) (specify O(size) without suffix). New (or additional) size of volume when O(state=resized). With the V(+) sign the value is added to the actual size of the volume and without it, the value is taken as an absolute one (specify O(size) with suffix V(KMGT)).

options.name: snapshot
options.description: Control qemu's snapshot mode feature. If activated, changes made to the disk are temporary and will be discarded when the VM is shutdown.

options.name: ssd
options.description: Whether to expose this drive as an SSD, rather than a rotational hard disk.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicates desired state of the disk. O(state=present) can be used to create, replace disk or update options in existing disk. It will create missing disk or update options in existing one by default. See the O(create) parameter description to control behavior of this option. Some updates on options (like O(cache)) are not being applied instantly and require VM restart. Use O(state=detached) to detach existing disk from VM but do not remove it entirely. When O(state=detached) and disk is V(unused

options.name: storage
options.description: The drive's backing storage. Used only when O(state) is V(present).

options.name: target_disk
options.description: The config key the disk will be moved to on the target VM (for example, V(ide0) or V(scsi1)). Default is the source disk key. Used only when O(state=moved).

options.name: target_storage
options.description: Move the disk to this storage when O(state=moved). You can move between storages only in scope of one VM. Mutually exclusive with O(target_vmid). Consider increasing O(timeout) in case of large disk images or slow storage backend.

options.name: target_vmid
options.description: The (unique) ID of the VM where disk will be placed when O(state=moved). You can move disk between VMs only when the same storage is used. Mutually exclusive with O(target_storage).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds to wait for slow operations such as importing disk or moving disk between storages. Used only when O(state) is V(present) or V(moved).

options.name: trans
options.description: Force disk geometry bios translation mode.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate the TLS certificates used for the connection to the Proxmox VE API. May be set through the environment variable E(PROXMOX_VALIDATE_CERTS).

options.name: vmid
options.description: The unique ID of the VM. You can specify either O(vmid) or O(name) or both of them.

options.name: werror
options.description: Write error action.

options.name: wwn
options.description: The drive's worldwide name, encoded as 16 bytes hex string, prefixed by V(0x).
